findings.issue: Qal perfect 3ms is active. “se inclinó” adds a reflexive pronoun the stem does not mark; the 3ms subject is unchanged.
Qal infinitive construct of sit/dwell plus Ar is rendered as the place-noun “morada de Ar”, narrowing the verbal range toward a residence in a genitive link.

notes: Conjunction, construct slope, definite plural torrents, relative, niphal lean, anarthrous border, Ar, and Moab stay inside the tokens.
